title: MusGU+: Toward a Musician-Centered Evaluation Framework and Discovery Tool for Generative Music AI
abstract: arXiv:2608.30940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative music systems are increasingly presented as tools that democratize music creation, yet their practical suitability for musicians remains underexplored. Prior work includes openness-focused evaluation frameworks, such as MusGO (Music-Generative Open AI), as well as qualitative studies of musicians' experiences with generative systems. However, these approaches do not support systematic comparison or early-stage discovery of models for creative use. Motivated by such limitations, we introduce MusGU+, a musician-centered evaluation framework organized around three dimensions: Adaptability, Usability, and Controllability. Together, these capture whether a model can be feasibly trained or fine-tuned on personal data, integrated into real-world music workflows, and controlled in musically meaningful ways. translated_title: MusGU+：面向音乐人的生成式音乐AI评估框架与发现工具
translated_abstract: 生成式音乐系统日益被呈现为使音乐创作民主化的工具，但其对音乐人的实际适用性仍未得到充分探索。先前的研究包括以开放性为重点的评估框架，如MusGO（Music-Generative Open AI），以及对音乐人使用生成式系统体验的定性研究。然而，这些方法不支持系统性的模型比较，也不支持面向创意用途的早期模型发现。受这些局限性的启发，我们提出了MusGU+，这是一个以音乐人为中心的评估框架，围绕三个维度组织：适应性、可用性和可控性。这三个维度共同衡量一个模型能否在个人数据上进行可行的训练或微调、能否集成到真实世界的音乐工作流程中，以及能否以具有音乐意义的方式加以控制。我们评估了10个代表性的生成式音乐系统，并提出了一个交互式发现工具，使音乐人能够探索（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了以音乐人为中心的生成式音乐AI评估框架MusGU+，从适应性、可用性和可控性三个维度评估了10个代表性系统，并提供了交互式发现工具帮助音乐人选择适合创意使用的模型。
en_tdlr: MusGU+ is a musician-centered evaluation framework for generative music AI built on three dimensions—Adaptability, Usability, and Controllability—which evaluates 10 representative systems and provides an interactive discovery tool to help musicians find suitable models for creative use.
